subject: DI02005011

body.en:
Definition

A mole contains exactly6.02214076×10²³specified entities.Relative atomic mass and relative molecular mass compare particle mass with1/12of a carbon12atom and are dimensionless.

Explanation and use

  • Molar mass M has g/mol or kg/kmol; its numerical value matches relative molecular mass on those units.Use n=m/M with compatible units.
  • Molecular formula gives M=Σ(number of atoms×atomic molar mass).For H2SO4 using H1, O16, S32, M=98g/mol=98kg/kmol.
  • 1kmol=1000mol; 1lbmol=453.59237mol.State whether entities are atoms, molecules, ions or formula units.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

એક moleમાં6.02214076×10²³specified entities હોય.Relative atomic/molecular mass particle massને carbon12atomના1/12સાથે સરખાવે અને નિરેક છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Molar mass Mના units g/mol/kg/kmol છે; આ unitsમાં numerical value relative molecular mass જેટલી.n=m/M compatible units સાથે લો.
  • Molecular formulaથી M=Σ(atom count×atomic molar mass).H1, O16, S32માં H2SO4નું M=98g/mol=98kg/kmol.
  • 1kmol=1000mol; 1lbmol=453.59237mol.Entities atoms, molecules, ions કે formula units છે તે જણાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Equivalent weight is molar mass divided by the reaction-specific equivalence factor f; the factor counts reactive charge or transferred electrons per formula amount.

Explanation and use

  • E=M/f in g/eq; equivalents=m/E.In acid-base work f is the number of H+ neutralised or OH−supplied in the specified reaction.
  • For complete neutralisation, H2SO4 has f=2, E=49g/eq.With a different reaction/endpoint, the factor may change; do not assign one universal normality to a substance.
  • Redox equivalent factors depend on oxidation-state change and medium; reaction must be stated before calculating E or normality.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Equivalent weight એટલે molar mass/reaction-specific equivalence factor f; f reactive charge કે transferred electronsનું પ્રમાણ બતાવે છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • E=M/f g/eq; equivalents=m/E.Acid-baseમાં specified reactionમાં neutralised H+ કે supplied OH−ની સંખ્યા f છે.
  • Complete neutralisationમાં H2SO4નું f=2, E=49g/eq.Reaction/endpoint બદલાય તો factor બદલાય; substanceને universal normality ન આપવી.
  • Redox factor oxidation-state change/medium પર આધારિત છે; E/normality પહેલાં reaction સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Specific gravity SG is the ratio of a substance density to a specified reference density at stated temperatures.API gravity is an inverse petroleum-density scale based on SG at60°F/60°F.

Explanation and use

  • For liquids/solids, SG=ρ/ρwater with temperature basis specified; SG is dimensionless.SG is not density in kg/m³.
  • °API=141.5/SG60/60−131.5; inverse SG60/60=141.5/(°API+131.5).Higher API means lower density on this basis.
  • Do not insert a liquid SG measured at an unrelated temperature without correction.Gas specific gravity commonly refers to air at the same T, P.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Specific gravity SG stated temperaturesએ substance/reference densityનો ratio છે.API gravity petroleumની inverse density scale છે, SG60°F/60°F આધારિત.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Liquids/solidsમાં SG=ρ/ρwater; temperature basis આપો.SG નિરેક છે, kg/m³ density નહીં.
  • °API=141.5/SG60/60−131.5; inverse SG60/60=141.5/(°API+131.5).Higher API એટલે આ basis પર lower density.
  • જુદા temperatureનું SG correction વિના APIમાં ન મૂકો.Gas SG સામાન્ય રીતે સમાન T, Pના air સામે હોય છે.

body.en:
Definition

A composition fraction is component amount divided by total mixture amount on a declared basis; mass, mole and liquid-volume fractions are generally different.

Explanation and use

  • Mass fraction wi=mi/Σmi; mole fraction xi=ni/Σni.Percent=100×fraction.Each complete set sums to1 or100%.
  • Mass→mole:xi=(wi/Mi)/Σ(wj/Mj).Mole→mass:wi=xiMi/ΣxjMj.Declare molecular masses and use one basis.
  • Mixture mean molar mass Mbar=ΣxiMi=1/Σ(wi/Mi).Do not arithmetically average molecular masses unless mole fractions are equal.
  • Volume fraction is Vi/Vtotal on a specified measurement basis.Liquid volumes may change on mixing; volume% is not automatically mole% or mass%.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Declared basis પર component amount/total mixture amount composition fraction છે; mass, mole તથા liquid-volume fractions સામાન્ય રીતે જુદાં હોય છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Mass fraction wi=mi/Σmi; mole fraction xi=ni/Σni; percent=100×fraction.Complete setનો sum1કે100%.
  • Mass→mole:xi=(wi/Mi)/Σ(wj/Mj); mole→mass:wi=xiMi/ΣxjMj.Molar masses/એક basis સ્પષ્ટ લો.
  • Mbar=ΣxiMi=1/Σ(wi/Mi).Mole fractions સમાન ન હોય તો molecular massesનું arithmetic mean ન લો.
  • Volume fraction Vi/Vtotal specified measurement basis પર.Liquid mixingમાં volume બદલાય; volume%=mole%કેmass% આપમેળે નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A concentration statement specifies solute amount relative to solution or solvent on an explicitly named mass, volume or mole basis.

Explanation and use

  • %w/w=g solute/100g solution; %w/v=g solute/100mL solution; %v/v=mL component/100mL final solution at stated T.
  • Mass ppm=mg/kg=mass fraction×10⁶; mass ppb=μg/kg.Only for sufficiently dilute water withρ≈1kg/L does1mg/L≈1mass ppm.
  • Solute/solvent mass ratio X=msolute/msolvent relates to mass fraction w=X/(1+X), X=w/(1−w).
  • Wet basis includes water in the denominator; dry basis excludes it.State the denominator before converting a moisture percentage.

Concentration denominators

MethodNumerator / denominatorUnit / condition
Mass%solute mass / total solution mass ×100%w/w
Mole%component moles / total moles ×100mol%
Volume%component volume / final solution volume ×100State temperature; liquid volumes may not add
%w/vg solute /100mL final solutiong/100mL
Mass ppmmg solute /kg solutionNot automatically mg/L
Molaritymol solute /L solutionmol/L
Normalityreaction equivalents /L solutioneq/L; reaction must be stated
Molalitymol solute /kg solventmol/kg solvent
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Concentration statementમાં soluteને solution/solventની સરખામણીએ explicit mass, volume/mole basis પર દર્શાવાય છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • %w/w=g solute/100g solution; %w/v=g solute/100mL solution; %v/v=mL component/100mL final solution stated Tએ.
  • Mass ppm=mg/kg=mass fraction×10⁶; mass ppb=μg/kg.Dilute water/ρ≈1kg/Lમાં જ1mg/L≈1mass ppm.
  • Solute/solvent ratio X=msolute/msolvent; w=X/(1+X), X=w/(1−w).
  • Wet basis denominatorમાં water સહિત, dry basisમાં water વગર.Moisture percentage convert કરતાં denominator લખો.

Concentrationનાં Denominators

Mass%solute mass / total solution mass ×100%w/w
Mole%component moles / total moles ×100mol%
Volume%component volume / final solution volume ×100T લખો; liquid volumes additive જરૂરી નથી

body.en:
Definition

Molarity c is moles solute per litre of solution; normality N is reaction equivalents per litre of solution; molality b is moles solute per kilogram solvent.

Explanation and use

  • c=n/Vsolution(L), N=equivalents/Vsolution(L)=fc, b=n/msolvent(kg).Molarity units mol/L, normality eq/L, molality mol/kg.
  • Solution volume is not solvent volume; molality uses solvent mass, not solution mass.Molarity depends on thermal volume changes more directly than molality.
  • For dilution of the same solute without reaction, c1V1=c2V2.Use N1V1=N2V2 only if the equivalence factor is unchanged.
  • For neutralisation at the specified endpoint, NacidVacid=NbaseVbase.Volume additivity is not assumed when preparing a final volumetric solution.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Molarity c=moles solute/litre solution; normality N=reaction equivalents/litre solution; molality b=moles solute/kg solvent.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • c=n/Vsolution(L), N=equivalents/Vsolution(L)=fc, b=n/msolvent(kg).Units mol/L, eq/L, mol/kg.
  • Solution volume solvent volume નથી; molalityમાં solvent mass, solution mass નહીં.Molarity thermal volume changesથી વધુ સીધી અસર પામે.
  • સમાન solute/no reaction dilutionમાં c1V1=c2V2.N1V1=N2V2 માટે factor સમાન જોઈએ.
  • Specified endpointએ NacidVacid=NbaseVbase.Final volumetric solution બનાવતાં volume additivity માની લેવી નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

m(H2SO4)=196g; H=1, S=32, O=16g/mol atomic molar masses.

To find

Find M, moles and formula entities.

Formula / necessary assumptions

M=Σatom counts×atomic molar mass; n=m/M; entities=nNA.

Calculation

  1. M=2×1+32+4×16=98g/mol.
  2. n=196/98=2mol.
  3. Entities=2×6.02214076×10²³=1.204428152×10²⁴.

Final answer

M=98g/mol; n=2mol; entities≈1.20443×10²⁴.

Check

g/(g/mol)=mol; relative molecular mass98 is dimensionless, unlike M.

ગણતરી

  1. M=2×1+32+4×16=98g/mol.
  2. n=196/98=2mol.
  3. Entities=2×6.02214076×10²³=1.204428152×10²⁴.

અંતિમ જવાબ

M=98g/mol; n=2mol; entities≈1.20443×10²⁴.

ચકાસણી

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Petroleum SG60°F/60°F=0.85.

To find

Find API and verify inverse SG.

Formula / necessary assumptions

°API=141.5/SG−131.5; SG=141.5/(°API+131.5).

Calculation

  1. °API=141.5/0.85−131.5=34.9706.
  2. SG=141.5/(34.9706+131.5)≈0.8500.

Final answer

API≈34.97°; SG=0.85.

Check

API increases as SG decreases; SG has no units.

Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

4.9g H2SO4 in final500mL solution; M=98g/mol; complete neutralisation f=2.

To find

Find molarity, equivalent weight and normality.

Formula / necessary assumptions

c=(m/M)/V(L); E=M/f; N=fc.

Calculation

  1. n=4.9/98=0.05mol; V=0.500L.
  2. c=0.05/0.500=0.100mol/L.
  3. E=98/2=49g/eq; N=2×0.100=0.200eq/L.

Final answer

c=0.100M; E=49g/eq; N=0.200N for the specified reaction.

Check

Normality requires the reaction factor; final solution volume is used.

Given data

25mL H2SO4 sample is fully neutralised by20mL of0.10N NaOH.

To find

Find acid normality and molarity.

Formula / necessary assumptions

H2SO4+2NaOH→Na2SO4+2H2O; NacidVacid=NbaseVbase; Nacid=2cacid.

Calculation

  1. Nacid=(0.10×20)/25=0.080eq/L.
  2. cacid=0.080/2=0.040mol/L.
  3. Acid equivalents=0.080×0.025=0.002eq=0.10×0.020.

Final answer

Acid0.080N and0.040M for complete neutralisation.

Check

Volumes may both be mL in the ratio, but convert to litres when computing total equivalents.

Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

NaOH solution20%w/w; ρ=1.20kg/L; MNaOH=40g/mol; f=1for acid-base neutralisation.

To find

Find c, N and b.

Formula / necessary assumptions

Take1L solution:msolution=ρV; msolute=wmsolution; msolvent=(1−w)msolution.

Calculation

  1. msolution=1.20kg=1200g; msolute=0.20×1200=240g.
  2. n=240/40=6mol; msolvent=0.80×1.20=0.96kg.
  3. c=6/1=6mol/L; N=1×6=6eq/L.
  4. b=6/0.96=6.25mol/kg solvent.

Final answer

c=6M; N=6N; b=6.25mol/kg.

Check

One litre solution contains0.96kg solvent, not1.20kg solvent.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

NaOH solution20%w/w; ρ=1.20kg/L; MNaOH=40g/mol; f=1for acid-base neutralisation.

શું શોધવું

c, N/b શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

Take1L solution:msolution=ρV; msolute=wmsolution; msolvent=(1−w)msolution.

ગણતરી

  1. msolution=1.20kg=1200g; msolute=0.20×1200=240g.
  2. n=240/40=6mol; msolvent=0.80×1.20=0.96kg.
  3. c=6/1=6mol/L; N=1×6=6eq/L.
  4. b=6/0.96=6.25mol/kg solvent.

અંતિમ જવાબ

c=6M; N=6N; b=6.25mol/kg.

ચકાસણી

1L solutionમાં0.96kg solvent છે, 1.20kg solvent નહીં.

q.en: Define: Mole,atomic weight and molecular weight
q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા આપો: Mole,Atomic Weight તથા Molecular Weight

a.en: A mole contains exactly6.02214076×10²³specified entities.Relative atomic mass and relative molecular mass compare particle mass with1/12of a carbon12atom and are dimensionless.
a.gu: એક moleમાં6.02214076×10²³specified entities હોય.Relative atomic/molecular mass particle massને carbon12atomના1/12સાથે સરખાવે અને નિરેક છે.

q.en: Define: Equivalent weight and reaction factor
q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા આપો: Equivalent Weight તથા Reaction Factor

a.en: Equivalent weight is molar mass divided by the reaction-specific equivalence factor f; the factor counts reactive charge or transferred electrons per formula amount.
a.gu: Equivalent weight એટલે molar mass/reaction-specific equivalence factor f; f reactive charge કે transferred electronsનું પ્રમાણ બતાવે છે.

q.en: Define: Specific gravity and API gravity
q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા આપો: Specific Gravity તથા API Gravity

a.en: Specific gravity SG is the ratio of a substance density to a specified reference density at stated temperatures.API gravity is an inverse petroleum-density scale based on SG at60°F/60°F.
a.gu: Specific gravity SG stated temperaturesએ substance/reference densityનો ratio છે.API gravity petroleumની inverse density scale છે, SG60°F/60°F આધારિત.

q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા આપો: Mass,Mole તથા Volume Composition

a.en: A composition fraction is component amount divided by total mixture amount on a declared basis; mass, mole and liquid-volume fractions are generally different.
a.gu: Declared basis પર component amount/total mixture amount composition fraction છે; mass, mole તથા liquid-volume fractions સામાન્ય રીતે જુદાં હોય છે.
